newsitem.title: USA: Philippine Long Distance files debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Long Distance files debt shelf.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co Wednesday filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in debt securities.
When combined with previous registrations, Philippine Long Distance will have a total offering of $500 million in debt securities available for sale.
Proceeds from the sale of the securities will be used by the company in connection with its proposed service improvements and expansion programs, the filing said.

Philippine Long Distance, based in Makati City, furnishes telephone services in the Philippines, with a network of 170 central office exchanges serving the metro Manila area and 181 cities and municipalities throughout the country.
